Subject: Request: Azure private plan billing flow & attestations for Nebula Health

Hi Evelyn,

Following our call this morning — thanks again for the demo. Nebula is evaluating a private plan listing on Azure Marketplace and we need to align on a few commercial and compliance points before we proceed:

- Billing & payment path: Can purchase be via private plan (MSP billing) with PO to Nebula and monthly invoices to our AP team? We need to confirm invoicing entity and tax ID.
- SOC 2 / security attestations: we need the latest SOC 2 Type II and a short attestation we can attach to our vendor questionnaire.
- Data residency: our data must remain in US regions for production workloads; please confirm region routing for the private SKU.
- Contract and SOW: we will send a Master Purchase Order; please confirm any redlines on Standard Azure Marketplace terms and whether Redwood accepts PRC / PO-first procurement.

I attached a draft PO and our standard vendor addendum for review. Can you loop in legal and finance? We are hoping to close procurement by EOW May 7.

Thanks,

Liam O'Connor
Procurement Manager
Nebula Health
procurement@nebulahealth.com

Thanks for the quick loop, Evelyn — appreciate it. A couple clarifications after reading your note: 

- We typically require SOC 2 Type II within the last 12 months and an explicit statement that Redwood will not move production customer data outside of US regions for Nebula's private plan SKU. A high-level attestation PDF is fine if a full SOC2 upload is not possible.
- On billing: AP will only process POs to the legal entity named on invoice. We need to know whether the invoice they receive will be from Redwood Inc. (US tax ID included) or from a Microsoft marketplace reseller.
- For PO timing: Nebula's PO workflow is 5 business days once we receive a confirmed invoice path and a signed order.

Attached our standard vendor addendum (we redlined a couple of clauses). If you can provide the SOC2 attestation and confirm the invoice entity + a short statement on regional routing, we can issue the PO Friday.

Liam
Attachment: Nebula_Vendor_Addendum_Redlines.docx (DOCX, 45 KB)

Hi Liam — thanks and good questions. Quick summary for procurement: 

1) Billing / Invoicing
- For Azure Private Plans, customers are billed via Microsoft but invoices can show Redwood as the "seller" line item for the private SKU when we publish as a Private Offer. That means Azure issues the invoice and collects payment, but the invoice includes our legal name and tax ID. Treasury has confirmed we can provide the US tax ID to appear on invoices. Marcus, please attach the tax ID file to the HubSpot deal.

2) SOC 2 / Attestation
- Attached is a short attestation PDF stating Redwood's SOC 2 Type II coverage and a link to our SOC2 report host. We cannot post the full report publicly, but the attestation plus a secure report share (via portal) is acceptable for most enterprise procurement teams. Attachment: Terms_Nebula_Redwood_v1_2027-05-04.pdf

3) Data residency / routing
- We support region pinning for private plan deployments. For Nebula's private SKU we will ensure production routing to US regions only and include that as an operational SLA in the SOW. Note: failover to other regions would only occur in declared disaster scenarios and will be communicated in advance.

4) Contracts / PO-first
- We can accept PO-first procurement for Marketplace private plans. Standard Azure Marketplace terms apply; any material redlines in your vendor addendum (indemnity limits, IP carveouts) are likely to require an amendment. Please send the redlines you most need preserved and we will escalate to legal.

Next steps: Marcus to upload tax ID and confirm invoice sample; Evelyn will send a short SOW with regional SLA and DocuSign order to expedite. If we can provide the attestation and invoice sample by EOD today, can you confirm PO issuance Friday?

Best,

Rachel Kim
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: Terms_Nebula_Redwood_v1_2027-05-04.pdf (PDF, 12 KB)
